ntsb_total.note: NTSB CAROL query 2026-10-24: Make or Model contains 'VELOCITY' (also Model contains 'XL'), filtered to XL-family model strings (XL-RG, XL-FG, XL-5, TXL, SUV) = 25 (24 accidents + 1 incident ERA15IA009), plus CEN19LA313 whose narrative identifies an XL-RG. 1999-06-15 to 2026-04-17. XL-RG-specific subset 19 (18 by model string + CEN19LA313). 28 further 'Velocity' events with no model given are excluded (some may be XL). All Velocity types: 95 events 1988-2026.

ntsb_fatal.note: 5 fatal accidents, 9 deaths (XL family): LAX02LA072 (2), CHI04FA215 (1), LAX06LA141 (1), MIA08FA070 (3), WPR10LA381 (2)

fleet_size_for_rate.note: Kitplanes Dec 2011 buyer's guide via Wikipedia: 229 XL-family completed (XL-RG 150, XL-FG 40, XL-FG-5 21, TXL-RG-5 18). FAA registry download 2026-10-24: 107 current US registrations with XL/TXL/SUV in make/model strings, 78 of them RG. Crude record: 26 events / ~230+ built.

safety.pattern: RECORD: XL-family causes - landing-phase loss of control/flare errors and gear-up or gear-collapse landings (ERA13CA426, GAA18CA148, ERA26LA182 gear not extended; ERA12LA431 nose-gear fatigue after shimmy; ERA25LA298, LAX06LA229); fuel (C-FPDL fatal fuel exhaustion LAX02LA072; MIA99LA184 starvation from mis-adjusted wing fuel caps/vent); engine/maintenance power losses (exhaust stack separation, aneroid setting, battery leads, undetermined); weather (CHI04FA215 VFR into IMC -> inverted flat spin and in-flight breakup, fatal; CEN18LA077 airframe icing); midair/runway collision (MIA08FA070, 3 killed). CONFIGURATION-SPECIFIC on record: (a) pusher: unlatched passenger door separated and struck the rear engine/prop -> power loss, 2 killed (WPR10LA381, Super XLRG5); propeller struck runway during aborted simulated forced landing (ERA13CA426); (b) NTSB found manufacturer's inadequate design of the winglet/rudder assembly and metal-to-composite bonding -> control-surface flutter on an XL-FG (ATL01LA029); (c) stall: XL-RG departed controlled flight during a self-planned stall test sequence and hit terrain nearly vertically with little horizontal speed, cause undetermined (LAX06LA141); XL-RG stall on go-around (WPR17LA032). No NTSB finding on rain/canard contamination found. INFERENCE (mine): LAX06LA141's near-vertical, low-forward-speed impact and CHI04FA215's flat spin are consistent with, but not proof of, a deep-stall/flat-spin mode; NTSB did not say so. Retractable-gear handling and pusher door/canopy-latch FOD are the clearest configuration-linked risks.

why_died_detail: Not dead: Velocity Inc. (Sebastian FL) still sells XL kits and lists current specs. History: founded 1984 by Danny Maher (first flight Oct 1985); bought 1992 by Duane and Scott Swing; sold 2008 to Rocket Racing Composite Corp (Rocket Racing League); Swings repurchased 2010; owned by the Swing family, ~20 staff, >590 aircraft all models (Wikipedia, Velocity, Inc.). ~650 kits sold/~350 flying all models by 2005 (GA News). Limits are those of a kit: build hours, retractable-gear insurance, hard-surface only.
